title: Office Floor
goal: A practitioner can read the office floor artefact at a glance.

rubric.must: A visible YOU ARE HERE marker, legend, and two marked exits are present.
Primary and secondary routes visibly lead from the marker to separate exits.
A reader can visually follow the principal flow or relationship from beginning to end.
Key labels remain legible and attached to the correct visible elements.
Lines and symbols do not visually imply unintended connections.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: Image 1 clearly distinguishes primary and alternative routes from the location marker to separate exits, while Image 2 leaves its marker disconnected from the evacuation route.
